Charity Work and Community Involvement

Damar Hamlin is taking on a new role beyond football, along with Under Armour to support young athletes dealing with mental health challenges. The Buffalo Bills safety has joined the brand's Protect This Mind initiative, almost three years after suffering cardiac arrest during an NFL game. The program aims to help student athletes manage stress, pressure and emotional struggles, giving Hamlin a chance to use his own experiences to encourage young people to take care of their mental wellbeing.The partnership aims to help young athletes cope with the demands of sports, school and personal life. Through Protect This Mind, Hamlin will help promote mental wellness resources for students, coaches and athletic communities. The initiative encourages young people to talk about their struggles and seek support rather than feel they have to deal with everything on their own.The partnership also connects with Hamlin's own experience of returning to football after a life-threatening medical emergency. His recovery brought physical and emotional challenges, and his involvement in the initiative gives him an opportunity to connect with young athletes who may be dealing with pressure or difficult situations of their own.Born on March 24, 1998, Hamlin grew up in McKees Rocks, Pennsylvania, near Pittsburgh. His parents, Nina and Mario Hamlin, played an important role in his upbringing. He faced challenges growing up, but his parents' efforts and sacrifices helped shape his determination to build a career in football.Hamlin remains close to his family and hometown. He has a younger brother, Damir, and has kept much of his personal life private. His connection to the community he grew up in is also reflected in his charitable work and efforts to support local children.Hamlin attended Pittsburgh Central Catholic High School, where he emerged as a promising defensive player. His performances earned him a place at the University of Pittsburgh, where he spent five seasons playing for the Panthers.He finished his college career with 275 tackles, six interceptions and 21 pass breakups. The Buffalo Bills picked him in the sixth round of the 2021 NFL Draft, with the 212th overall selection.Hamlin made his NFL debut in September 2021 and earned more playing time in Buffalo's defensive lineup. He made significant progress during the 2022 season, recording 88 tackles and becoming a dependable contributor to the team.On January 2, 2023, Hamlin suffered cardiac arrest during a game against the Cincinnati Bengals. Medical personnel immediately performed CPR and used a defibrillator to restore his heartbeat before he was taken to hospital. The incident shocked the football community, with teammates, fans and players from across the country rallying behind him.After recovering, Hamlin began working toward a return to football. Getting back on the field meant rebuilding his strength and confidence after the frightening experience. He returned during the 2023 season and received recognition for his comeback, including the PFWA Comeback Player of the Year award.Hamlin founded the Chasing M's Foundation in 2020, starting with a toy drive for children at his mother's daycare centre. Following his cardiac arrest, the foundation received an outpouring of public support, allowing it to expand its work.The foundation supports young people through scholarships, football camps, donation drives and community programs. Hamlin has also worked to raise awareness about CPR and the importance of having automated external defibrillators available, helping more people understand how they can respond during medical emergencies.Giving back has become an important part of his life, particularly in the community where he grew up. Article Title: Aaron Rodgers could lose $2.5 million after Steelers make stunning benching decision ahead of Broncos clash
Article Text:
Aaron Rodgers faces a $2.5 million setback after Steelers' surprise QB decision (Getty Images)

Aaron Rodgers' $2.5 million incentives are now under threat

Steelers are unsure how Rodgers will respond to the benching

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

The Pittsburgh Steelers have made a major change at quarterback ahead of their Black Friday meeting with the Denver Broncos, leaving Aaron Rodgers facing an unexpected setback. Pittsburgh announced late Tuesday that Mason Rudolph will start at Acrisure Stadium, while Rodgers will be inactive despite not appearing on the injury report. The decision also carries financial consequences for the veteran quarterback. Rodgers has up to $2.5 million in playoff incentives written into his contract, but his reduced playing time could put that money in jeopardy as Pittsburgh changes direction after back-to-back defeats.Aaron Rodgers' absence against Denver does not immediately rule him out of earning his playoff bonuses. However, the Steelers' decision makes his path considerably more complicated.According to details shared by Steelers Depot on X, Rodgers must play at least 75% of Pittsburgh's regular-season offensive snaps to become eligible for the incentives.“If you are scoring at home, the Aaron Rodgers contract includes up to $2.5 million in playoff incentives he can earn, all of which require him to first play 75% of the Steelers' regular-season snaps. #Steelers #NFL”The contract contains four separate bonuses worth $625,000 each.Rodgers can earn one for every playoff victory, covering the wild-card round, divisional round, AFC Championship Game and Super Bowl.He has played approximately 97% of the Steelers' offensive snaps through their first 10 games. Missing Friday's contest alone would not push him below the required mark. The bigger concern is what happens if Rudolph keeps the starting job for the remaining regular-season games.The 75% requirement covers the entire regular season, not just the games Rodgers has already played. Every additional week on the sideline would reduce his share of the team's total offensive snaps. Even if he meets that requirement, Pittsburgh must win the corresponding playoff games for him to collect the bonuses.For a quarterback who joined the Steelers hoping to make one more championship run, the financial setback could become another consequence of a difficult season.The timing of Pittsburgh's announcement has raised another question. Head coach Mike McCarthy had backed Aaron Rodgers as the starter just a day before the team confirmed the change. NFL insider Jordan Schultz reported that the Steelers were also uncertain about the quarterback's reaction to the decision.“The #Steelers do not know how Aaron Rodgers will react to tonight’s news,” Schultz reported. “‘I guess we’ll find out together,' a source said.”That uncertainty adds another layer to an already uncomfortable situation. McCarthy and Rodgers previously worked together in Green Bay, winning a Super Bowl before their paths eventually separated. Their reunion in Pittsburgh was supposed to give the Steelers an experienced leader for what Rodgers had described as his final NFL season.Instead, two consecutive losses have left Pittsburgh searching for answers. The Steelers are 6-4 after Sunday's 19-16 defeat to the Philadelphia Eagles, and their offense has struggled to produce consistently.Rodgers has completed 60.9% of his passes for 2,241 yards, 16 touchdowns and six interceptions in 10 starts. His 86.6 passer rating is a career low, and he has been sacked 31 times.Against Philadelphia, he completed 30 of 44 attempts for 227 yards and a touchdown, but the Eagles brought him down five times. Pittsburgh managed only one touchdown before the final minutes.Rudolph now gets the opportunity to change that picture. He has a 9-9-1 record across 19 career starts with Pittsburgh and Tennessee. The Steelers have not confirmed who will start after Friday, leaving Rodgers' immediate future uncertain and his playoff incentives dependent on a return to the lineup.
Article Summary: Aaron Rodgers has up to $2.5 million in playoff incentives written into his contract, but his reduced playing time could put that money in jeopardy. Pittsburgh announced late Tuesday that Mason Rudolph will start at Acrisure Stadium, while Rodgers will be inactive despite not appearing on the injury report.

Article Title: Sam Darnold injury update: Seahawks keep 49ers guessing ahead of crucial Week 12 showdown
Article Text:
Sam Darnold's injury status remains uncertain as the Seattle Seahawks prepare for their Week 12 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers (Getty Images)

Sam Darnold's return remains the priority for Seattle

Drew Lock also benefits from the bye week

Seahawks could force 49ers to prepare for both quarterbacks

The Seattle Seahawks are preparing for a crucial Week 12 clash against the San Francisco 49ers, with Sam Darnold's fitness emerging as a key storyline. The quarterback has missed the last two games with quad and rib injuries, but Seattle is hopeful he can return after the bye. Head coach Mike Macdonald has not confirmed Darnold's availability, leaving the 49ers with an important question to answer during their preparations. Seattle enters the matchup with playoff ambitions, and having its starting quarterback back could make a significant difference against a division rival.Darnold has been the Seahawks' designated starter when healthy, and Macdonald has maintained that position despite Drew Lock winning both games during his absence. The team now needs to see how Darnold responds to the pace of practice before making a final decision.Macdonald offered a cautious update on the quarterback's work during the bye week."He was able to train a little bit here, do some rehab here, he also was able to get away. He's optimistic, but I think with today's practice cadence and speed of today, it's probably wise to wait to make any declarations until we get through Wednesday's practice," Macdonald said of Darnold's bye week via the team's website.The comments suggest progress, but they stop short of confirming a return. Darnold still has to show he can handle the demands of a full practice without aggravating either injury.Lock has given Seattle a reliable option while Darnold recovers. He helped the Seahawks win their previous two games, making the quarterback decision more complicated than it might have been earlier in the season.However, Lock was also managing an oblique injury before Seattle's previous game against the Las Vegas Raiders. The break gave him time to recover, which could leave the Seahawks with two healthier quarterbacks heading into the 49ers matchup."I'd say the bye week was really helpful for Drew," Macdonald said via the team's website. "A really well-deserved chance for him to feel better, and that's going to help us moving forward. I think that's the case for several of our guys as well."Seattle has little reason to rush an announcement before Darnold completes the next stage of his recovery. If he avoids a setback and handles the practice workload, he is expected to reclaim the starting job.Keeping the decision open also creates a practical challenge for San Francisco. The 49ers must prepare for Darnold's return while accounting for Lock, who has already shown he can lead the offense to wins.The Seahawks and 49ers are scheduled to kick off at 1:25 pm PT on Sunday at Levi's Stadium. The game will air on FOX and stream on the FOX One app.

Article Title: Meet Rishikesh Kumar: US-returned MBA groom marrying Mokama MLA Anant Singh's daughter Shivangi in Bihar's most talked-about wedding, complete with 5 helipads, a horse race and a feast for 4 lakh gues
Article Text:
Mokama MLA Anant Singh is preparing for an extravagant wedding for his daughter Shivangi on November 25 (Photo credit: X)

Who is Rishikesh Kumar?

A luxury Defender and a BMW for the family

Five helipads, Jaipur-inspired mandap and horse race

An SUV for the horse race winner

A feast for around four lakh guests





PATNA: Five helipads for VIP guests, a horse race with an SUV as the top prize, luxury cars and a wedding feast planned for around four lakh people. Mokama MLA Anant Singh is leaving no stone unturned for his daughter Shivangi’s wedding, with preparations at his ancestral village turning the celebrations into one of Bihar’s most talked-about events.Spread across large grounds, the arrangements include a Jaipur-inspired wedding pavilion, special lighting, elaborate floral decorations and a separate venue for the horse-racing competition.The scale of the preparations, along with the expensive gifts and the expected guest list, has drawn considerable attention even before the wedding ceremonies begin.But amid all the grandeur, there is another person at the centre of the celebrations: Rishikesh Kumar, also known as Ankit, who is set to marry Shivangi on November 25. While the wedding has put the spotlight on the Singh family, many are curious about the groom and his background.Rishikesh is the son of Ranvijay Kumar, a commandant in the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF), who belongs to Krishnanagar in Bihta, Patna. The groom holds an MBA degree and has lived in the United States for around 11 years.Rishikesh’s educational background and years in the US have emerged as key details about the groom as the wedding draws attention.He is set to marry Singh’s younger daughter Shivangi on November 25.The celebrations have already featured expensive gifts.A Land Rover Defender, estimated to cost between Rs 2.5 crore and Rs 3 crore, has been arranged for the bridegroom. A BMW worth around Rs 1 crore has also been arranged for Singh’s younger son, Abhinav, whose janeu ceremony will take place alongside the wedding.The Defender was chosen by Shivangi and gifted to her on her birthday, according to her brother-in-law Puneet Kumar, who married Singh’s eldest daughter Raj Nandini in 2015.The wedding venue at Singh’s ancestral village of Nadawan in Patna district is being developed across more than 10 bighas. A separate ground spread over nearly 12 bighas has been prepared for a horse-racing competition.The main attraction will be a Jaipur-inspired stage and mandap for the jaimala ceremony. The structure is planned to be around 100 feet wide, 35 feet long and 30 feet high. Flowers are being sourced from China and Bengaluru, while special lighting equipment has been brought in from Bengal.Five helipads are also being constructed for VIP guests.The wedding celebrations will include a horse-racing competition scheduled for November 25, from 2pm to 4pm. The winner will receive an SUV, while the second and third-place finishers will get a motorcycle and a scooter.The event is expected to bring horses and riders from several states. A stable is also being constructed at Nadawan to accommodate the animals.Food is expected to be another major attraction, with more than 150 varieties planned for the wedding feast. The arrangements are expected to cater to around four lakh guests.The menu will include traditional Bihari dishes as well as food from other states. Sweets will include kaju katli and Silao khaja, a speciality from Nalanda.As the wedding day approaches, the celebrations are set to bring together family, guests and political figures for one of Bihar’s most talked-about weddings.
Article Summary: Mokama MLA Anant Singh is preparing for an extravagant wedding for his daughter Shivangi on November 25. A Land Rover Defender, estimated to cost between Rs 2.5 crore and Rs 3 crore, has been arranged for the bridegroom. Five helipads for VIP guests, a horse race with an SUV as the top prize, luxury cars and a wedding feast planned for around four lakh people.

Article Title: Mike McCarthy’s Aaron Rodgers comments preceded Mason Rudolph’s unexpected Pittsburgh Steelers starting opportunity
Article Text:
Mike McCarthy’s Aaron Rodgers comments preceded Mason Rudolph’s unexpected Pittsburgh Steelers starting opportunity (Image via Getty: Aaron Rodgers and Mason Rudolph)

Mason Rudolph gets Steelers starting nod just a day after Mike McCarthy backed Aaron Rodgers

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Pittsburgh Steelers’ 2026 NFL playoff chances

The Pittsburgh Steelers have finally granted some fans’ wishes by benching Aaron Rodgers . After losing two games in a row, the team didn’t want a third loss to further jeopardize their fading playoff hopes.Since returning from their bye week - which may have been an ayahuasca retreat for Rodgers [though, he probably doesn’t do those during the season] -the Steelers have suffered back-to-back defeats: one to a Super Bowl contender, the Cincinnati Bengals, and another to the Philadelphia Eagles, who were playing without their franchise quarterback, Jalen Hurts. Instead, Joe Milton III started for Philadelphia in Week 11 against Pittsburgh.This loss likely left Rodgers, the coaches, and the front office questioning whether their 42-year-old starter can still perform on the gridiron.As a result, according to NFL insider Tom Pelissero, Pittsburgh head coach Mike McCarthy decided to rest the veteran QB and give Mason Rudolph - their 2018 third-round pick - a chance to prove himself.Head coach Mike McCarthy believed in Aaron Rodgers until Monday. When asked about making a QB change that day, McCarthy sounded confused that the question was even raised.A reporter asked if the team was considering a change at quarterback because the offense was struggling, and McCarthy adamantly stated that Rodgers was their guy. Yet by Tuesday night, they had benched Rodgers and named Mason Rudolph the starter.The reporter had asked, “You have four quarterbacks on the active roster, and with the offense struggling the way it has, do you consider using any of the others or mixing things up to give the offense a different look?”To which, the coach replied, “Like a quarterback halfback pass or something? Are you talking about trick plays, or…?”“Or putting Mason in when—” the reporter began, before being interrupted by McCarthy: “No, Aaron Rodgers is our quarterback.”Rudolph is a 31-year-old NFL quarterback who played college football for Oklahoma State before spending seven seasons with the Pittsburgh Steelers and one with the Tennessee Titans.The 6-foot-5, 235-pounder has accumulated modest stats over the past nine years: 476 completions on 742 attempts for 4,927 passing yards, 30 touchdowns, and 22 interceptions.The Northwestern alum’s career passer rating is 84.3, with a 64.2% completion rate. He holds a 9–9–1 record in the regular season and is 0–1 in the playoffs. During his lone season with the Titans in 2024, he struggled to find success, going just 1–4 as a starter.It wouldn’t be surprising if the Steelers lose their upcoming Week 12 matchup against the Denver Broncos, given Rudolph’s past starting record. Still, we never know - this is a midseason opportunity, and he will likely be eager to turn his NFL career around.This move could also mean Pittsburgh is resting the retirement-prone Rodgers or saving him for bigger games - assuming they make it that far. Ultimately, the QB switch raises serious questions about their chances of reaching the 2026 playoffs.The AFC playoff picture entering Week 12 puts the Pittsburgh Steelers in seventh place, behind the Buffalo Bills, Denver Broncos, Jacksonville Jaguars, Cincinnati Bengals, Kansas City Chiefs, and Cleveland Browns.The Steelers have a 62% chance of making the 2026 NFL playoffs. If they win Week 12 vs. the Denver Broncos, their chances soar to 77%. If they lose, their chances drop to 54%.They have a less than 1% chance of claiming the No. 1 seed and a 9% chance of winning the AFC North - something the Aaron Rodgers-led Steelers did last season, finishing first with a 10–7 regular-season record.
Article Summary: Mason Rudolph gets Steelers starting nod just a day after Mike McCarthy backed Aaron Rodgers. Steelers have suffered back-to-back defeats: one to a Super Bowl contender, the Cincinnati Bengals, and another to the Philadelphia Eagles, who were playing without their franchise quarterback, Jalen Hurts.

Article Title: 'Play 20 balls, the score will be different': How Yuvraj Singh's 30-minute call unleashed Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking 204
Article Text:
Vaibhav Sooryavanshi (Pic credit: BCCI)

'My mind was a little diverted': Yuvraj's advice helped him rediscover his game

Backing his strengths after assessing the conditions

NEW DELHI: A half-hour conversation with his idol and mentor Yuvraj Singh proved to be the turning point for Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, who went on to produce one of the most extraordinary batting performances in the history of the game, smashing a world-record 204 off just 53 balls against the UAE in the Asia Cup Rising Stars tournament on Tuesday.The 15-year-old left-hander revealed that he had been struggling with his form and was mentally distracted by a string of low scores before the match. Seeking clarity, he turned to four people, including his father, childhood coach Manish Hoja, former India Under-19 teammate Pratham Jachak and Yuvraj.But it was the conversation with Yuvraj that helped him identify technical flaws, regain confidence and approach his innings with a clearer mindset.In a video shared by the BCCI , Sooryavanshi opened up about the conversation and how the former India all-rounder's advice shaped his approach against the UAE."I spoke to him [Yuvraj Singh] for almost half an hour. He explained a lot to me about batting. I was very worried, so I spoke to him openly. Sir, I am having these problems. When I am going to bat on the wicket. He explained everything to me for half an hour. He told me that if I play 20 balls, the score will be different.He told me a lot of technical things. That helped me a lot today," Sooryavanshi said.Sooryavanshi admitted that his recent struggles had left him questioning his approach, with the youngster unable to score runs in his previous two matches and a few domestic outings.He said Yuvraj's advice carried particular weight because of the admiration he has for the former India all-rounder."It's not easy, but as I told you, the last two matches and a few domestic matches, I couldn't score runs. I was a little diverted, and kept asking myself what is happening. But I spoke to Yuvraj sir, he is my idol. If you talk to an idol, you listen to everything he says. I listened to everything he said. He told me a lot of important things," he said.Sooryavanshi also revealed that reviewing videos of his batting helped him recognise the mistakes he had been making. He then tried to implement Yuvraj's suggestions rather than repeat those errors."I saw the video of my batting. I felt that I was making a mistake. I tried not to make those mistake today. I tried to do what he told me to do. He helped me a lot," he added.The teenager's innings against the UAE was a remarkable display of power-hitting, but he insisted that his approach was not simply about attacking from the outset. Instead, he first assessed the conditions before deciding to play to his strengths."I just had the mindset to go and see how the wicket was. I went and saw a couple of balls. The ball was coming well on the bat, so I backed my game," he explained.Sooryavanshi also reiterated that he does not consider himself a batter restricted to one format, saying he has the ability to adjust his approach according to the demands of the game."When I was interviewed after the IPL in Ahmedabad, I said that I can play in all three formats. I can change the game according to the situation. I have that much control over my game," he said.He admitted, however, that he had been trying to play the same way in recent matches, even attempting to adopt a longer-format approach when the situation did not necessarily demand it."But in the last two matches, I was trying to play the same way. I was trying to play in a long format. Even today, I had the same mindset. But when I saw the wicket, I didn't feel much help. If I tried to take shots, the ball was coming to my bat. So I backed my strength," he concluded.The result was an astonishing 204 off 53 balls, featuring 28 sixes and seven fours, as India registered a seven-wicket victory over the UAE.
Article Summary: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi smashed a world-record 204 off just 53 balls against the UAE. The 15-year-old revealed that he had been struggling with his form and was mentally distracted by a string of low scores before the match. A half-hour conversation with his idol and mentor Yuvraj Singh proved to be the turning point for the youngster.

Article Title: Jay-Z’s Super Bowl halftime show is getting a historic Hollywood treatment; what NFL and music fans can expect
Article Text:
Super Bowl LXI will be shown live in hundreds of IMAX theaters on Feb. 14, a first for the game. (NFL)

Jay-Z's Super Bowl halftime show heads to IMAX screens

Ticket dates, theaters and what to know before February

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

The Super Bowl is going to the movies. For the first time in the game's 61-year history, Super Bowl LXI will play live in IMAX theaters across the country, including Jay-Z's halftime show. The NFL, ESPN and Disney announced the plan on Monday, Nov. 23. The game kicks off Feb. 14 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California. Hundreds of screens will carry a four-hour package that covers the pregame, the game, the halftime set and postgame coverage. It is also ESPN's first Super Bowl broadcast. Tickets go on sale in January, and the theater list is still to come.IMAX says this is the biggest live event it has ever carried, according to Variety. Theaters in the United States and select international markets will take part. The broadcast comes from ESPN's coverage at SoFi Stadium, so viewers get the same game as everyone at home. The difference is the room. A giant screen and cinema sound change how a halftime set lands, and Jay-Z's show is the obvious test case.Plenty of people watch the Super Bowl for the halftime show and care little about who lifts the Lombardi Trophy.For them, a seat in a dark theater with a stage production on a screen that size may beat a couch. Football fans get the stadium feel. Jay-Z fans get a performance at a quality usually saved for big film releases.Ken Potrock, Disney's president of major event integration, framed it as a shared experience. "Watching the Super Bowl with your fellow fans is one of the great shared experiences in sports, and this first-of-its-kind collaboration with the NFL and IMAX takes it to a historic new scale," he said in a statement.IMAX has tried live sports before, including Formula 1. The Super Bowl pulls a much wider crowd.Tickets are expected to go on sale in January, about a month before kickoff. The theater list and ticket details are due in the coming weeks. Fans can sign up for updates on the IMAX website. Promotion starts early. Ads for the event are set to run in theaters this week, so Thanksgiving moviegoers may get the first look.The date adds a twist. Super Bowl Sunday lands on Valentine's Day in 2027, which gives couples a plan that suits both the football watcher and the person who wants a night out. Whether a four-hour cinema booking works as a date is another matter.This is SoFi Stadium's second Super Bowl and the ninth in the Los Angeles area. The Rams beat the Bengals 23-20 there in 2022. The first Super Bowl was played at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum in 1967, so the league is returning to a city tied to the game from day one.Jay-Z takes the headline slot, and some of his fans may buy a ticket for those minutes alone.
Article Summary: Super Bowl LXI will be shown live in hundreds of IMAX theaters on Feb. 14. Hundreds of screens will carry a four-hour package that covers the pregame, the game, the halftime set and postgame coverage. Tickets go on sale in January, and the theater list is still to come.

Article Title: 'Address: Tihar Jail, work: To Kill': How D-Company-linked gangster Naseem Durrani's long run ended in UP
Article Text:
Image Credit: TOI/ Special arrangement

How the net closed in

A chequered history





NEW DELHI: For years, Naseem Durrani moved between the gritty turf wars of northeast Delhi and the far-reaching shadow of Mumbai’s underworld — a man whose criminal ledger stretched from neighborhood extortion rackets to alleged hit contracts tied to Dawood Ibrahim ’s "D-Company."Beyond his crimes on the ground, Naseem actively used social media to cultivate a climate of fear among people. His Instagram profile served as an overt display of intimidation, featuring a bio that read: "Name: Badnaam (Notorious) | Address: Tihar Jail | Age: To live | Work: To kill." Through this digital persona, he openly advertised his criminal background while remaining absconding from law enforcement.On Friday, that long run ended in a hail of gunfire in Uttar Pradesh’s Bulandshahr district, where a joint operation by the Noida Special Task Force (STF) and Delhi Police cornered and killed the wanted gangster.Acting on intelligence inputs tracking Durrani’s movements, Delhi crime branch team led by DCP Sanjeev Yadav and deputy superintendent of police R K Mishra from STF Noida mounted a coordinated operation in Bulandshahr, supervised by special CP HGS Dhaliwal.In the early hours, the cops detected his movement near the Sikandra Bypass. CCTV footage showed him riding a scooter, and when the police team moved in to arrest him, he repeatedly looked back at the pursuing officers while speeding away.​During the chase, Naseem's scooter skidded and fell. Armed with two .32-bore pistols, he opened fire on the police team, prompting officers to retaliate. He sustained multiple gunshot wounds in the exchange of fire, and police recovered both pistols from the spot.The breakthrough came days after a brazen daylight-style shooting in northeast Delhi put law enforcement on high alert. Investigators had been scanning CCTV footage, tracing escape routes, and following leads in the wake of a deadly attack in Khajuri Khas.While police files linked Durrani to more than 25 criminal cases — spanning murder, attempt to murder, and robbery — his profile extended well beyond local street crime. The first was a killing outside Delhi law minister Kapil Mishra's camp office where 26-year-old Sameer was shot dead with over a dozen rounds fired in the attack.Police scrutiny following the recent violence has pointed to a prolonged gang feud in northeast Delhi, allegedly driven by extortion demands targeting shared auto-rickshaw operators and scrap dealers. Durrani had also previously been named as a key accused in the May 26 killing of Raja Mewati, alias "Akki Don," in Khajuri Khas.Investigators noted that Durrani had links to Dawood Ibrahim’s D-Company and remained in contact with underworld figure Chhota Shakeel. According to reports, Shakeel had allegedly handed Durrani a contract during 2016–2017 to eliminate rival gangster Chhota Rajan, who was lodged in Tihar Jail.With Durrani killed in the Bulandshahr encounter, investigators are expected to examine how his network operated across the Delhi-NCR and western Uttar Pradesh belt, as well as any lingering fallout from the ongoing turf wars in northeast Delhi.
Article Summary: Gangster Naseem Durrani was shot dead by police in Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh. He was wanted in more than 25 criminal cases spanning murder, attempt to murder, and robbery. His criminal ledger stretched from neighborhood extortion rackets to alleged hit contracts tied to Dawood Ibrahim’s "D-Company"
